groups.UsersOneGroupNote: Users can only be in one group at a time. If you don't see your user in the list they are already in a group.

groups.type_and_validation: New defaults OrganizationalGroup1. StationGroup2 accepts an address route, a coordinate route, or What3Words. Group.Name is required, max50. The chosen group type is displayed disabled on Edit; no conversion exercise is supported. Use unique names and read the catalog before creation; do not assume a duplicate-name validator exists.
groups.parent: Normal New parent dropdown offers None plus top-level groups. Edit offers top-level groups excluding itself. Either group type can have a parent. Server helper independently rejects absent/cross-department/self/descendant parents and cycles. The create page ParentGroup is outside StationAddress and remains a normal field; obsolete ParentFields script references are not evidence that the actual dropdown is hidden.
groups.station_validation: When What3Words is blank and BOTH latitude/longitude are empty, Station validates Street,City,Country,PostalCode,State. With a coordinate route, always enter BOTH valid latitude/longitude values. The controller’s emptiness branch is not a robust half-pair validator; do not teach a partial coordinate as valid.
groups.geo_provider_effects: Nonblank What3Words invokes the configured geo provider during the POST before final ModelState success. Address-route save persists an Address; later group/map coordinate resolution can geocode that address or department fallback. Stored valid coordinate pairs resolve before boundary/address/provider fallbacks. Manual fictional complete pair with blank What3Words/address avoids the W3W/address-resolution path for that station; no GPS/device lookup or real-address validation is implied.
groups.selectors: GroupAdmins and GroupUsers are explicit width100% multi-selects. New recipient lookup filter3/filterNotInGroup excludes anyone in any department group. Edit adds ignoreGroupId so current members can be retained. Existing members/admins load asynchronously as named chips. A person cannot appear in both lists; UI rejects overlap and server also validates it. Existing grouped members cannot be silently added to another group.
groups.whole_selection_save: Edit builds the complete desired membership list from both submitted selectors. DepartmentGroupsService.UpdateAsync removes omitted members, adds new ones and updates IsAdmin; submitting no selected members clears the group. Wait for every baseline chip before any populated-group save. This plan never edits existing memberships or grants GroupAdmin.
groups.provider_and_communications: Group create generates internal dispatch/message alias strings and audits/refreshes projections; this is not an inbound-email or message-delivery test. Leave SelectPrinter/GetPrinters/API-key/printing/fax paths untouched; printer selection invokes PrintNode-related calls and persists encrypted credentials if configured.

units.availability: Units Index shows Add capability according to CanDepartmentAddNewUnit. Use the ordinary visible launcher; no plan/feature override. Standard create/update permissions and same-department checks still apply.
units.type: A unit’s Type selector uses department type NAMES as values. Create only an own new type with explicit ClassNone, ActionsStandardActions, MapIconDefault and no custom file. Do not rename/delete existing types or change status sets. Type controller requires a nonblank name and normal add permission; existing map/status/class effects are type configuration, not crew assignment.
units.station: New Unit lists NoStation plus Station-type department groups; Organizational groups are not offered in the station list. A station is optional in the controller. Prefer the own new Station for clear readback. Do not change station assignments of existing units.
units.seat_definitions: Name is required and checked for department duplicate name. Unit role names must be unique within the posted form; blank roles are skipped. AddRole appends a role name, optional RequiredPersonnelRole selector and Required? checkbox. This configures a seat/requirement, not a person. BrowseTemplates appends role rows locally; template application is not saved until the unit save. Inspect/Close rather than apply if not needed.
units.required_vs_preferred: For a seat linked to a personnel role, Required? checked blocks an unqualified person assignment in UnitStaffing; unchecked is a preferred qualification and may produce degraded staffing instead. A personnel-role match is a software role condition, not professional authorization or physical presence.
units.edit_replacement: EditUnit replaces that unit’s seat definitions through SetRolesForUnitAsync, which clears old definitions and re-inserts posted ones; no rows clears all definitions. Restrict edits to the own new unused unit; do not resave Engine51 or other existing seat definitions.
units.global_staffing_hazard: UnitStaffing Save validates required personnel-role conditions first, but then deletes active crew for EVERY department unit and rebuilds only submitted nonempty Role_* selections. Keep this screen READ-ONLY in the planned lesson. This preserves Engine51/Herrmann and all existing crew. Do not use a filtered/partially loaded or incomplete form for an own-unit-only save.
units.normal_creation_side_effect: NewUnit saves the row/roles then calls the configured Novu CreateUnitSubscriber path. It attempts subscriber registration, not notification delivery. No provider/backend configuration or secret entry is part of this exercise; if UI reports an error, verify actual saved list/readback before retrying to avoid duplicates.
units.no_status_claim: Creation is not a dispatch/check-in/arrival/status action. Read the actual returned list; do not infer availability, staffed ratio, map position or a delivered notification from a successful form submit.

source_only_limits: No new entities, UI operations, DB queries, provider requests, configuration or permission changes were performed by this reviewer.
Every proposed save/result still requires genuine normal UI captures and fresh readback. No successful group/unit/provider action is asserted here.
Group selectors may honestly be empty because all current fictional personnel already belong to groups. Do not move them or create credentials/invites just to populate the demonstration.
No global crew assignment save, existing unit/type/group edit, hidden input injection, geolocation permission, real location or template/statutory claim.
